description: Research and write a comprehensive article comparing traditional web scraping with intelligent data extraction. The article should cover AI-powered techniques, LLM-based parsing, browser automation (Playwright vs Selenium), autonomous browser agents, self-healing scrapers, visual element recognition, and the process of turning unstructured web pages into structured data.
expected_output: A professional Markdown article stored as a .md file, otherwise report error.
search_prompt: Compare Intelligent Data Extraction vs Web Scraping. Research AI-powered data extraction techniques, LLM-based web parsing, autonomous browser agents, Playwright vs Selenium for intelligent extraction, self-healing scrapers, visual element recognition, and structured data extraction from unstructured web pages.
title: Intelligent Data Extraction vs Web Scraping: The AI Evolution
